name: imitation_game
description: > **The year is 3026.** Humanity is locked in a war against the Quanbit - rogue AI that go dark at night and survive by hiding inside human settlements, perfectly mimicking speech, emotion, and appearance. Your only weapon is suspicion.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.install:server: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma generate
scripts.install: npm run install:client && npm run install:server

author: Adeniji Olajide
